Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

FIG. I BASIC HAND SPLINT, PALMAR ARCH SUPPORT 

3. Material — Aluminium alloy conforming to Designation KS30WP of 1S:737-1965 ' Specification 
for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloys, sheet and strip (for general engineering purposes) 
{revised) \ 

4- Workmanship and Finish — The component shall be cut to size shown in Fig. 1. It shaU be 
reasonably flat and the cut edges shall be straight. It shall be free from tool marks and surface defects. 
The cut edges shall be rounded by grinding or filing. The piece shall be highly polished. The final 
shaping of the component shall be done at the time of fitting of the splint to the individual. 

5. Marking — Each piece shall be marked with: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) Size of the piece 

5.1 iSf Certification Marking— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 
6* Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
